meta.title: SSAS Performance Assessment
meta.subtitle: Evidence-driven findings, prioritization, and implementation roadmap
meta.confidentiality: Internal — assessment evidence may contain sensitive model metadata

coverage.note: Metadata model dan VertiPaq storage tersedia untuk ranking relatif.
Partition, dimension usage, relationship, hierarchy, aggregation, dan MDX hash tersedia.
118 query seluruhnya metadata/schema discovery; tidak ada business MDX.
Belum ada 2–3 refresh normal dan processing event per partition.
Wajib divalidasi sebelum penghapusan atau perubahan object.
DMV mahal sengaja dinonaktifkan; memory pressure belum dapat disimpulkan.

signals: Empat tabel ≥1 juta rows dengan ≤1 partition
Dictionary hotspot dan 48 static DAX pattern hits
candidates.action: Reproduce top query hashes, profile Server Timings, review cardinality/dependency, lalu pilot partition bertanggal yang non-overlap.
candidates.validation: Semantic parity, query warm runs, 2–3 normal refresh runs, row reconciliation, dan rollback gate.

signals: Satu tabel ≥1 juta rows dengan ≤1 partition
candidates.action: Profile hash pembentuk P95/max dan capture processing events; pilot partition hanya bila date boundary valid.
candidates.validation: Repeated query benchmark, processing before/after, reconciliation, dan rollback.

signals: Satu dari dua execution mendominasi sample
candidates.action: Map dua hashes ke report/owner, reproduce outlier dengan warm runs, dan capture Server Timings.
candidates.validation: Minimal tiga comparable runs; typical latency belum dapat disimpulkan dari sample saat ini.

signals: Satu SELECT * dan satu complex source
candidates.action: Map hashes ke report, review calculated-column dependency dan explicit source projection.
candidates.validation: Dependency scan, semantic tests, serta query/processing before-after.

signals: Empat fact ≥1 juta rows dengan ≤1 partition
candidates.action: Capture business workload dan processing per fact sebelum partition, relationship, source, atau DAX change.
candidates.validation: Runtime baseline, partition boundary parity, processing metrics, and semantic regression.

signals: Dua tabel ≥1 juta rows dengan ≤1 partition
candidates.action: Collect workload/processing, validate cardinality and dependency, then pilot partition only when boundaries are proven.
candidates.validation: Size/cardinality, query and processing benchmark, semantic parity, rollback.

signals: Dua tabel ≥1 juta rows dengan ≤1 partition
candidates.action: Reproduce outlier, capture processing/boundaries, and review cardinality plus source complexity.
candidates.validation: Repeated query, 2–3 refresh runs, partition row reconciliation, rollback.

candidates.action: Diagram relationship/RLS path, validate bidirectional need, and profile complex filter paths.
candidates.validation: Filter-path queries, relationship parity, Server Timings, and rollback.

roadmap.focus: Query ownership, representative warm runs, 2–3 normal refresh runs, processing events
roadmap.outcome: Comparable baseline and accepted success criteria

roadmap.focus: Explicit projection, measured source fixes, dependency-approved storage hygiene
roadmap.outcome: Reduced transfer/model width with semantic parity

roadmap.focus: Partition, relationship, aggregation, and measured DAX/MDX changes
Controlled deployment, monitoring, governance, and evidence refresh

validation: Use 3–5 representative business queries per candidate: one warm-up and at least three comparable warm runs.
Use 2–3 normal refresh/processing runs before and after an approved tuning change.
Record database, query hash/name, cache mode, total/FE/SE metrics when available, partition, rows, status, and errors.
Require semantic-result parity, row reconciliation, downstream validation, and an executable rollback plan.
Do not treat missing, skipped, or unsupported evidence as a performance defect.
